common: Create a polished horizontal anime wallpaper featuring exactly one sweet, cute young adult female character in a joyful fruit-themed fantasy. Kawaii fashion editorial illustration: expressive sparkling eyes, charming natural smile, harmonious pastel colors with fresh fruit-colored accents, detailed but readable costume construction. Fully clothed, opaque bodice and lined layered skirt, no sexual emphasis. Use imaginative fruit-inspired Lolita or fairytale fashion rather than a fruit mascot suit. Full figure including the shoes, with comfortable space around the head, hair, hands and feet. Wide-angle environmental composition, layered near/far depth, asymmetrical placement and a clear sweeping movement through flowing hair, ribbons and skirt. Keep the face legible and anatomy coherent, with two arms, two legs and clear hands. One dominant fruit theme must be instantly identifiable through real fruit shapes, color, props and environment. Preserve the requested hair color and eye color. Give the scene a beautiful atmosphere with controlled soft light, rich clean colors and crisp focal contours. No captions, letters, logo, watermark, panels, collage or page border.

jobs.title: 草莓奶油的空中茶会
jobs.scene: Strawberry and whipped cream fantasy. A girl with long rose-pink twin tails and emerald-green eyes skips through the air from a giant porcelain teacup toward a floating strawberry garden. Her strawberry-red and ivory Lolita dress has a fitted opaque bodice, layered scalloped cream lace, tiny strawberry embroidery, green leaf-shaped bows and red high-heeled Mary Jane shoes with white socks. Her nearer hand presents a small dish with one whole ripe strawberry, while her other arm balances outward; skirt and hair sweep behind her. A 24mm low viewpoint looks past large softly blurred strawberries and cream-colored roses toward floating dessert terraces, pink clouds and tiny glowing sugar-like lights. Sweet jewel-colored anime rendering, fresh red berries with visible green calyxes, a bright airy afternoon without white haze.

jobs.title: 蜜桃云间的轻盈一跃
jobs.scene: Peach fantasy at a luminous sunrise. A girl with long honey-blonde wavy hair and clear violet eyes leaps lightly across translucent peach-colored clouds above a tiny orchard. She wears a peach-pink and ivory Lolita dress with Chinese cloud-shaped collar details, green ribbon knots, layered peach-blossom-like scalloped hems and ivory high-heeled ankle boots. Her right hand carries a small woven basket containing ripe fuzzy peaches, her left arm reaches sideways, one knee bends while the other leg extends gracefully. A sweeping wide-angle diagonal view frames a huge floating peach-shaped glass greenhouse, blossom branches and distant soft green hills. Real round peaches with a central seam, pale blush and green leaves appear in the basket and orchard. Prismatic morning light, luminous delicate rendering, readable creamy fabric and bright pink midtones.

jobs.title: 柠檬汽水的微风旋舞
jobs.scene: Lemon soda and crystal greenhouse fantasy. A girl with a mint-green bob and sky-blue eyes twirls on a curving glass walkway above sparkling pale turquoise soda water. Her lemon-yellow and white Lolita dress has citrus-wedge pleats, narrow lace, green leaf bows, puffed sleeves and white high-heeled lace-up boots. In one hand she holds a small closed lemon-yellow parasol like a dance prop, while the other hand lifts outward in balance. Her full figure is seen through a sweeping 24mm three-quarter view, with a large translucent lemon slice in the near foreground, fresh whole yellow lemons and glossy leaves around curved glass arches, crystal bubbles rising into the air and blue sky beyond. Clear translucent colored glazes, crisp jewel-like eyes, gentle sparkling daylight and clean white highlights. Playful dynamic skirt swirl without obscuring the boots.

jobs.title: 葡萄藤上的紫色圆舞曲
jobs.scene: Grape-vine celestial conservatory fantasy. A girl with flowing deep indigo hair and amber-gold eyes swings sideways from a thick living grapevine loop suspended above a magical vineyard. She wears an ornate plum-purple and ivory Lolita dress with grape-cluster embroidery, green leaf lace, curling vine ribbon details and violet high-heeled knee boots. One hand securely holds the vine above her, the other reaches outward, her legs bend differently in a clear buoyant swing. A dramatic low wide-angle viewpoint includes a close bunch of round purple grapes, translucent purple fruit pavilions, layered arched glass roofs, rich violet foliage and cool turquoise distant clouds. Numerous intact recognizable grape clusters with green stems, luminous late afternoon sun filtering through leaves, intricate yet readable colored contours, a playful lavender and teal atmosphere.

jobs.title: 蓝莓湖上的纸船旅行
jobs.scene: Blueberry storybook lake fantasy. A girl with long pale silver-blue hair and rose-pink eyes balances playfully on the bow of a giant folded-paper boat drifting over a luminous blueberry-blue lake. She wears a periwinkle and white Lolita dress with round blueberry embroidery, scalloped lace, a blue ribbon at the waist, a tiny blueberry-and-leaf hair clip and navy high-heeled Mary Jane shoes. One leg lifts behind her; one arm reaches toward a floating blueberry lantern, while the other holds a small basket of ripe blueberries close to her side. A wide-angle low water-level view makes near ripples large and distant blue-green hills tiny. Whole blueberries with visible blossom-end crowns float gently like islands; oversized blueberry bushes and a pale yellow moon complete the dreamy twilight scene. Soft cute anime rendering, gentle lavender-blue color and warm small accent lights.

jobs.title: 蜜瓜玻璃宫的夏日舞步
jobs.scene: Honeydew melon and cream summer fantasy. A girl with fluffy apricot-orange hair in two loose side buns and aqua-green eyes makes a cheerful dancing step inside a huge translucent melon-shaped glass palace. Her pale mint-green and ivory Lolita dress has delicately netted melon-rind embroidery, cream lace, small melon-slice bows and ivory high-heeled calf boots with green laces. She carries one neat melon wedge on a small plate in her left hand while extending her right hand toward the viewer. A lively wide-angle diagonal shot shows her full figure, curving glass balconies, net-patterned round melons, fresh pale green melon wedges and tiny cream-colored fountains. Hair ribbons and tiered skirt swing with the dance. Fresh mint and cream palette, bright summer sky, soft clean luminous anime shading and appealing sparkling eyes, with no white fog.

jobs.title: 樱桃缎带的花园快步
jobs.scene: Cherry and ribbon fairytale garden. A girl with long dark chocolate-brown hair in a high ponytail and clear ruby-red eyes runs lightly across a suspended ribbon bridge between giant cherry trees. She wears a cherry-red and cream Lolita dress with paired-cherry motifs, a little gingham panel, white ruffled sleeves, green leaf ribbons and dark red high-heeled ankle boots. One hand steadies a small basket filled with paired ripe cherries, and her free hand reaches outward as her ponytail and long green ribbon stream behind her. Use a wide-angle three-quarter side view with cherries and leaves softly framing the near edge, the girl in the middle distance and delicate glass garden houses far below. Clearly recognizable paired red cherries joined by long green stems. Warm dappled sunlight, delicate tinted drawing, luminous cream and scarlet color, lively but gentle storybook sweetness.

jobs.title: 橙子摩天轮的晴空飞行
jobs.scene: Orange citrus amusement park in the sky. A girl with long lilac hair in a flowing braid and bright turquoise eyes floats outward beside an enormous ferris wheel whose gondolas resemble orange segments. Her vivid tangerine and white Lolita dress has clean citrus-slice panels, white scalloped lace, green leaf bows and white high-heeled knee boots with orange trim. She hugs a small round orange-shaped handbag with one hand and joyfully waves with the other. Her legs form a lively asymmetrical airborne pose. A dramatic low wide-angle view passes a large fresh orange slice in the foreground toward the complete girl, looping ribbons, the ferris wheel and small floating orange orchards beneath a clean azure sky. Recognizable round oranges and sliced citrus wheels with visible segments. High-chroma orange, turquoise and violet accents, crisp colored shadow shapes and clear anime linework, sunny optimistic atmosphere.
